gen-press-start-2p-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans packs its lines tight, gaps nearly gone. Press Start 2P sits above it with pixel-pinned letters spread far apart, and that jostle between cramped and scattered is the pair's best trick.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-truculenta: Chunky, retro, a bit cheeky: Press Start 2P brings big open lowercase bowls and widely spaced letters. And Truculenta follows in a compact, tall-lowercase line whose rounded shapes stay open, which makes the pairing feel like game night with a tidy notebook.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-victor-mono: Press Start 2P spaces its cut-out letters far apart. Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, takes up that looseness and gives the heading a structured, precise partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-viga: Viga keeps its strokes free of hairlines and shadows, with capitals barely taller than their neighbors. Viga is the quiet one here, while Press Start 2P scatters retro, far-apart letters across the heading and plays the show-off.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-voces: Retro and playful up top, with Press Start 2P spacing its letters far apart. And Voces answers in tall lowercase with stems and hairlines close in thickness, so the pair's strongest quality is how far apart their moods sit.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-winky-sans: Pixel-bright and a little goofy, Press Start 2P brings big open lowercase bowls. And Winky Sans comes in modern and neutral, its capitals barely taller than lowercase, which makes the pair's biggest strength a clear split in personality.
gen-press-start-2p-outfit: Press Start 2P goes retro and playful, its letters pinned far apart like cut-outs. Outfit follows in a smooth sans-serif whose curves finish well before they close, so a long read feels light and uncluttered.
gen-press-start-2p-plus-jakarta-sans: Press Start 2P brings a fun, retro heading with big open lowercase bowls and widely pinned spacing. Plus Jakarta Sans follows with a monoline sans whose curve endings stay well apart, so reading feels modern and precise.
gen-press-start-2p-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe. Give this sans-serif a bit more size than you think it needs, and Press Start 2P can keep its retro swagger above it.
gen-righteous-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps the gaps in its curves generous, a contemporary sans with low contrast. And Righteous, drawn like bent steel rod with no thick-and-thin at all, can stay at its own size while Amulya gets a little extra.
